mapper.sql: SELECT id, summary_id, qr_code, work_order_code, task_id, material_id, inventory_element_id, feed_amount, unit_id, request_json, response_json, upload_status, error_message, fail_type, retry_count, feed_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time FROM inspection_feed_record
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inspection_feed_record ( summary_id, qr_code, work_order_code, task_id, material_id, inventory_element_id, feed_amount, unit_id, request_json, response_json, upload_status, error_message, fail_type, retry_count, feed_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time ) VALUES ( #{summaryId}, #{qrCode}, #{workOrderCode}, #{taskId}, #{materialId}, #{inventoryElementId}, #{feedAmount}, #{unitId}, #{requestJson}, #{responseJson}, #{uploadStatus}, #{errorMessage}, #{failType}, #{retryCount}, #{feedTime}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{updateBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.update: UPDATE inspection_feed_record SET upload_status = 'PROCESSING', error_message = NULL, fail_type = NULL, update_time = sysdate() WHERE id = #{id} AND upload_status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE inspection_feed_record SET upload_status = 'PROCESSING', retry_count = retry_count + 1, error_message = NULL, fail_type = NULL, update_time = sysdate() WHERE id = #{id} AND upload_status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED')

UPDATE inspection_feed_record SET upload_status = 'SUCCESS', request_json = #{requestJson}, response_json = #{responseJson}, error_message = NULL, fail_type = NULL, feed_time = #{feedTime}, update_time = sysdate() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE inspection_feed_record SET upload_status = 'FAILED', request_json = #{requestJson}, response_json = #{responseJson}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, fail_type = #{failType}, feed_time = NULL, update_time = sysdate() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE inspection_feed_record SET upload_status = 'UNKNOWN', request_json = #{requestJson}, response_json = #{responseJson}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, fail_type = #{failType}, feed_time = NULL, update_time = sysdate() WHERE id = #{id}
